what: runtime probe of **flip=1 shots and multi-soldier / Bot campaign levels (18-20)**: per shot, the sampler arguments (**flip**, mode, x0/y0/step + the token stream fed in), the returned point array (ptr, n, digest, **first/last point -> sampling direction**), the `FunctionPointsEvent` assembly at 0x456810 (owner_id / start = pts[0] / end_x = pts[len-1].x) and the JSON writer 0x50eb20, and the 16 bytes the report reads (pos = pts[n-1] at execute_results 0x472865).
why_this_gap: every runtime sample before this round was Level 16/17 (single soldier, our side, flip=0). flip=1 (Team2 shooting towards -x) had ZERO samples, and Levels 18-20 (3/4/5 soldiers + a Bot) had none either.

how_to_make_flip1.summary: flip comes from the **team** (graphwar_turn_manager::Team::flip: Team1 x<=0 -> flip=0, Team2 x>=0 -> flip=1; docs/archive/105-team-sides.md). In campaign the player is always Team1, so our own shots are flip=0. **The Bot is Team2** => the shot the Bot fires right after ours is the flip=1 sample: enter a campaign level that HAS an opponent and just wait for its turn.
how_to_make_flip1.levels_with_a_bot: campaign level index -> docs/10-campaign.md 4: L5(bot_0), L9(bot_2), L11(bot_3), L14(bot_3), L15(bot_4), L18(bot_3), L19(bot_3), L20(bot_4)
steps: level node #18 / #19 / #20 (1187,751) / (1429,751) / (1672,751)  [3 rows x 7 cols, snake numbering]
click the input box (1000,1090) -> ctrl+a -> type the expression -> long-press Fire! (1855,55) 2 s
do NOT type the next expression immediately: the Bot takes its turn now, and ITS shot is the flip=1 sample (x0 > 0, points run towards -x, owner_id = the Bot soldier)
how_to_make_flip1.ui_check: in Levels 18-20 the prompt reads `dy/dx =` (func=1, DiffEq); the Bot fires by itself.

build.address_space: RVA = ELF virtual address = module offset; Ghidra address = RVA + 0x100000

how.driver: tools/frida_flip_probe.py --attach (NOT frida spawn: spawn hangs the game in wait4)
how.probe: tools/frida_flip_probe.js (read-only Interceptor hooks; no memory writes)
how.sampler_abi: 0x3c2530 (out: Vec<(f64,f64)> = rdi, tokens: &TokenBuf{cap,ptr,len} = rsi, FLIP = edx, MODE = ecx [0=Normal, 1=Ode], x0 = xmm0, y0 = xmm1, step = xmm2). Read off the prologue; 0x3c25a4 `test %bpl,%bpl` is the flip branch.
how.fnpoints_abi: 0x456810: rdi=self, esi=owner_id (u32), rdx=&Vec<(f64,f64)>; the body reads pts[len-1].x (0x4569b8) -> end_x and pts[0] (0x4569be) -> start_x/start_y. 0x50eb20 writes them into the JSON: rsi=&event{start_x@0,start_y@8,end_x@0x10,owner_id@0x18}.
how.digest: FNV-1a 64 over ALL 16*n bytes (`digest_xy`) and over the y halves only (`digest_y`), computed INSIDE the game process at the moment of the call (probe `digestOf`).

array_digest_spec.bytes: one point array = 16*n bytes: 8 bytes of x (little-endian f64) + 8 bytes of y (little-endian f64), in point order
array_digest_spec.sha256: SHA-256 over exactly those 16*n bytes, computed by the driver from the probe's `arr.hex` when the sample is extracted (whole arrays are NOT committed)
array_digest_spec.fnv: FNV-1a-64 over the same 16*n bytes (`digest_xy`) / over the y halves only (`digest_y`)
array_digest_spec.verify: re-run the driver with `--full-array`, take `arr.hex`, sha256 it — it must equal `arr.sha256` here; the driver ALSO recomputes FNV from the same bytes and compares with the probe-time digest (`arr.digest_selfcheck`)

how.positive_control: probe self-test at install: two 100-point synthetic arrays -> same; flip 1 bit at point 37 -> diffPoints=1; flip one more at point 90 -> 2. Runtime: flip=0 and flip=1 shots of the same match produce opposite array directions and different digests, so the comparison code does report differences on real data.

cut: per shot: expression typed (host marker + marker_dt_ms), flip/mode/x0/y0/step, the token stream fed to the sampler ({tag, value-bits}), the array the report reads (ptr, n, digest, first/last/second-last point), the derived sampling direction (`arr_dir`) and x0 sign, the other sampler calls of the same shot, the `FunctionPoints` assembly + JSON writer, the execute_results queue snapshot, and the 16 bytes read by the `movdqu` (pos_x/pos_y).
dropped: beat rows, whole-array hex, and every evaluator sample except the first few.
no_local_paths: no filesystem path and no user name; pointers are ASLR-random per run.
notes: flip=1 的造法：进有对手的战役关（Level 18/19/20 各 1 个 Bot），Bot 属于 Team2 ⇒ 它开火的每一发采样器 edx=1；我方（Team1）自己打的发 edx=0。Level 18/20 实测 Bot 先手、Level 19 实测我方先手 ⇒ 驱动按探针的 flip=1 计数自动判回合。

每发一条：pos_read + report_array_calc（token 流 + (ptr,n) + 首末点 + sha256/FNV 摘要）+ 同一发紧邻的另一次真发调用（lean；其余只计数）+ 进化器候选计数 + FunctionPoints 装配(0x456810)/JSON 写入器(0x50eb20) + execute_results 队列快照（去重后的数组摘要）。整条数组的字节不入库，只留摘要（口径见 provenance.array_digest_spec）。
